def test_sorted_list_sum():
    # empty list
    assert sorted_list_sum([]) == []

    # filters odd lengths
    assert sorted_list_sum(["aa", "a", "aaa"]) == ["aa"]
    assert sorted_list_sum(["a", "b", "c"]) == []
    assert sorted_list_sum(["school", "AI", "asdf", "b"]) == ["AI", "asdf", "school"]

    # sorted by length ascending
    assert sorted_list_sum(["aaaa", "a", "aa", "aaa"]) == ["aa", "aaaa"]
    assert sorted_list_sum(["AI", "asdf", "school"]) == ["AI", "asdf", "school"]

    # same length -> sorted alphabetically
    assert sorted_list_sum(["ab", "aa", "cd", "a"]) == ["aa", "ab", "cd"]
    assert sorted_list_sum(["dc", "ba", "ab"]) == ["ab", "ba", "dc"]
